description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Critical Damage +50%] to all allies for 25 seconds, grants [Awoken Wind], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Hard Blast Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Critical Damage +50%
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)

description.name: Awoken Wind
description.text: Wind abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Hard Blast Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Hard Blast after using three Wind abilities
